what: API list prices per million tokens, used by task_queue_ops.py `usage` to ESTIMATE what a dispatched task would cost at API rates. An estimate, not a bill: claude and codex run on subscriptions here, so nothing is charged per token.
source: Anthropic first-party API price table (Claude API skill, models overview, cached 2026-06-24; Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 cache-read rates as stated there); cache multipliers from the same skill's prompt-caching page
unpriced: Models not listed (codex's gpt-* models among them: no verified source yet) show tokens but no amount. Add a row with its source instead of guessing.
free: opencode models are free when opencode itself reports a cost of 0 and the model is in the free pool file opencode-fallback-models or ends in -free; a non-zero opencode cost is opencode's own figure.
